question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Pull a long face.
solution:
The correct answer is "**To look sad**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**to look sad, glum, disapproving, etc.**"
 
• We use the given idiom in a situation where we have just heard a **piece of disappointing news or witnessed something disheartening**.
 
 
• **Example**: *Our daughter** pulls a long face**__ every time we ask her to study.*
 
 

​​Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**
